WITH latest_run AS (
    SELECT
        scrape_run_id,
        products_count
    FROM "solar_prices"."bronze"."scrape_runs"
    WHERE status = 'SUCCESS'
    ORDER BY finished_at DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
),

run_quality AS (
    SELECT
        r.scrape_run_id,
        r.products_count AS expected_count,
        COUNT(p.scrape_id) AS actual_count,

        COUNT(p.scrape_id) FILTER (
            WHERE p.source_url IS NULL
               OR TRIM(p.source_url) = ''
        ) AS missing_urls,

        COUNT(p.scrape_id)
            - COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(p.source_url), ''))
            AS non_unique_urls

    FROM latest_run r
    LEFT JOIN "solar_prices"."bronze"."panel_scrape_raw" p
        ON r.scrape_run_id = p.scrape_run_id
    GROUP BY
        r.scrape_run_id,
        r.products_count
)

SELECT *
FROM run_quality
WHERE actual_count = 0
   OR expected_count IS NULL
   OR actual_count <> expected_count
   OR missing_urls > 0
   OR non_unique_urls > 0

WITH source_data AS (
    SELECT
        p.scrape_id,
        p.scrape_run_id,
        p.title,
        p.price_text,
        p.power_text,
        p.efficiency_text,
        p.bifaciality_text,
        p.source_url,
        p.is_available,
        p.scraped_at
    FROM "solar_prices"."bronze"."panel_scrape_raw" p
    INNER JOIN "solar_prices"."bronze"."scrape_runs" r
        ON p.scrape_run_id = r.scrape_run_id
    WHERE r.status = 'SUCCESS'
)

SELECT
    scrape_id,
    scrape_run_id,
    title,

    CASE
        WHEN TRIM(price_text) ~ '^[0-9]+([.,][0-9]{1,2})?$'
        THEN REPLACE(TRIM(price_text), ',', '.')::NUMERIC(12,2)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS price_pln,

    CASE
        WHEN TRIM(power_text) ~ '^[0-9]+[[:space:]]*[Ww]?$'
        THEN SUBSTRING(power_text FROM '[0-9]+')::INTEGER
        ELSE NULL
    END AS power_w,

    NULLIF(TRIM(source_url), '') AS source_url,
    is_available,
    scraped_at

FROM source_data

WITH latest_run AS (
    SELECT scrape_run_id
    FROM "solar_prices"."bronze"."scrape_runs"
    WHERE status = 'SUCCESS'
    ORDER BY finished_at DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
),

latest_panels AS (
    SELECT p.*
    FROM "solar_prices"."silver"."stg_panels" p
    INNER JOIN latest_run r
        ON p.scrape_run_id = r.scrape_run_id
    WHERE p.price_pln > 0
      AND p.power_w > 0
      AND p.source_url IS NOT NULL
),

deduplicated AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY source_url
            ORDER BY scraped_at DESC, scrape_id DESC
        ) AS product_row
    FROM latest_panels
),

metrics AS (
    SELECT
        scrape_id,
        scrape_run_id,
        title,
        source_url,
        price_pln,
        power_w,
        is_available,
        scraped_at,

        ROUND(
            price_pln / power_w, 4
        ) AS pln_per_watt,

        ROUND(
            power_w / price_pln, 4
        ) AS watt_per_pln,

        CASE
            WHEN price_pln < 200 THEN '<200 zł'
            WHEN price_pln < 300 THEN '200-300 zł'
            WHEN price_pln < 400 THEN '300-400 zł'
            ELSE '400+ zł'
        END AS price_category

    FROM deduplicated
    WHERE product_row = 1
)

SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY
            CASE WHEN is_available THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
            pln_per_watt ASC,
            title ASC
    ) AS overall_rank,

    *
FROM metrics
